to invigilate an exam.cn: 该教师被指派监考期末考试，以确保严格遵守规则。

to issue a permit.en: The government decided to issue a permit for the new construction project.
to issue a permit.cn: 政府决定批准该新建项目的许可。

to issue an ultimatum.en: The government decided to issue an ultimatum demanding immediate compliance with the new regulations.
to issue an ultimatum.cn: 政府决定发出最后通牒，要求立即遵守新法规。

to jettison fuel.en: The plane had to jettison fuel to reduce weight and ensure a safe landing.
to jettison fuel.cn: 飞机不得不排放燃油以减轻重量，确保安全着陆。

to launch a communications satellite.en: The agency successfully launched a communications satellite into orbit yesterday.
to launch a communications satellite.cn: 该机构昨日成功将通信卫星送入轨道。

to launch a research programme.en: The university aims to launch a comprehensive research programme next year.
to launch a research programme.cn: 该校计划明年启动一项综合研究项目。

to lead a blameless life.en: He strives to lead a blameless life, avoiding all wrongdoing and maintaining his integrity.
to lead a blameless life.cn: 他致力于过清白的生活，避免一切过错，坚守自己的操守。

to lose your faith.en: After years of setbacks, he finally lost his faith in the project's success.
to lose your faith.cn: 历经多年挫折后，他最终失去了对该项目成功的信心。

to make a categorical statement.en: The judge refused to make a categorical statement until all evidence was fully examined.
to make a categorical statement.cn: 法官在全面审查所有证据之前，拒绝作出明确断言。

to make a conscious decision.en: She made a conscious decision to quit her job and pursue her dream.
to make a conscious decision.cn: 她经过深思熟虑，决定辞职去追求自己的梦想。

to make a forced landing.en: The pilot made a forced landing due to the sudden engine failure.
to make a forced landing.cn: 飞机因引擎突然故障被迫迫降。

to navigate by the stars.en: We must navigate by the stars, as the electronic compass has failed us.
to navigate by the stars.cn: 我们必须依靠星辰导航，因为电子罗盘已失灵。

to negotiate a peace settlement.en: They finally negotiated a peace settlement after months of intense diplomatic talks.
to negotiate a peace settlement.cn: 经过数月的激烈外交谈判，他们最终达成了和平协议。

to overstep your authority.en: The manager was fired for overstepping his authority by making that decision.
to overstep your authority.cn: 该经理因越权做决定而被解雇。

to pander to sb's wishes.en: He constantly panders to his boss's whims, sacrificing his own principles in the process.
to pander to sb's wishes.cn: 他一味迎合上司的喜好，不惜牺牲自己的原则。

to pay a deposit.en: Before signing the lease, you must pay a deposit to secure your new apartment.
to pay a deposit.cn: 签约前，您需缴纳押金以确保新公寓的预订。

to pay sb a pittance.en: The company pays its staff only a pittance, barely enough to cover their basic living expenses.
to pay sb a pittance.cn: 该公司仅付给员工微薄的薪水，勉强够维持基本生活开支。

to peddle malicious gossip.en: She tried to peddle malicious gossip about her colleague's private life.
to peddle malicious gossip.cn: 她试图散布关于同事私生活的恶意流言。

to perform an autopsy.en: The coroner ordered the police to perform an autopsy on the victim.
to perform an autopsy.cn: 验尸官下令对死者进行尸体解剖。

to perpetuate injustice.en: We must take decisive action to stop the cycle that perpetuates injustice.
to perpetuate injustice.cn: 我们必须采取果断行动，制止延续不公的恶性循环。

to propose marriage.en: He finally proposed marriage to her after years of dating.
to propose marriage.cn: 多年恋爱后，他终于向她求婚。

to prove sth conclusively.en: The new data will conclusively prove that the theory is fundamentally flawed.
to prove sth conclusively.cn: 新数据将确凿证明该理论存在根本性缺陷。

to provide for retirement.en: The government plans to provide for retirement by expanding the pension system.
to provide for retirement.cn: 政府计划通过扩大养老金制度来提供退休保障。

to pursue legal action.en: The company decided to pursue legal action against the negligent driver.
to pursue legal action.cn: 该公司决定起诉那名疏忽大意的司机。

to receive a fair trial.en: The defendant insists on receiving a fair trial before any verdict is announced.
to receive a fair trial.cn: 被告坚持在宣判前获得公平审判。

to receive the last rites.en: Before he died, he received the last rites from the priest with great reverence.
to receive the last rites.cn: 临终前，他怀着极大的虔诚接受了神父的圣礼。

to recruit a task force.en: The government decided to recruit a task force to investigate the scandal.
to recruit a task force.cn: 政府决定组建特别小组调查丑闻。

to rectify a fault.en: The committee must act immediately to rectify the serious safety fault.
to rectify a fault.cn: 委员会必须立即纠正这一严重的安全隐患。

to redress an injustice.en: The court ruled to redress the injustice suffered by the minority group.
to redress an injustice.cn: 法院裁定对少数群体所受的冤屈予以纠正。

to relieve traffic congestion.en: The new high-speed rail line aims to relieve traffic congestion in the city center.
to relieve traffic congestion.cn: 这条新建的高速铁路旨在缓解市中心交通拥堵。

to remedy a problem.en: We must find an effective way to remedy the growing environmental crisis.
to remedy a problem.cn: 我们必须找到一种有效方法来应对日益严峻的环境危机。

to render sb a service.en: The government promised to render the citizens a better service.
to render sb a service.cn: 政府承诺为市民提供更好的服务。

to repudiate a suggestion.en: He firmly repudiated the suggestion that we should delay the project indefinitely.
to repudiate a suggestion.cn: 他坚决驳斥了无限期拖延该项目的建议。

to rerun an experiment.en: Researchers decided to rerun the experiment to verify their initial findings.
to rerun an experiment.cn: 研究人员决定重新进行实验，以验证其初步发现。

to retain your independence.en: She decided to retain her independence by starting her own business.
to retain your independence.cn: 她决定通过创业来保持独立。

to retract an offer.en: The company decided to retract an offer after the client's budget was cut.
to retract an offer.cn: 客户预算削减后，该公司决定撤回报价。

to reveal a secret.en: The scandal revealed a secret that had been buried for decades.
to reveal a secret.cn: 该丑闻揭露了一个埋藏数十年的秘密。

to rid yourself of guilt.en: She finally found a way to rid herself of the crushing guilt that had plagued her for years.
to rid yourself of guilt.cn: 她终于找到摆脱多年来折磨自己的沉重内疚的方法。

to rob a bank.en: They were arrested for attempting to rob a bank last night.
to rob a bank.cn: 他们因昨晚企图抢劫银行被捕。

to run out of petrol.en: The car suddenly stopped because we had completely run out of petrol.
to run out of petrol.cn: 汽车突然停了下来，因为汽油已完全耗尽。

to safeguard jobs.en: The government introduced new policies to safeguard jobs in the struggling manufacturing sector.
to safeguard jobs.cn: 政府出台新政策以保护陷入困境的制造业就业。

to sail into harbour.en: The ship finally managed to sail into the harbour after a long storm.
to sail into harbour.cn: 历经暴风雨后，船只终于驶入港湾。

to satisfy sb's curiosity.en: The mysterious artifact finally satisfied the historian's long-standing curiosity.
to satisfy sb's curiosity.cn: 这件神秘的文物终于满足了历史学家多年的好奇。

to save sb's life.en: The doctor worked tirelessly to save the patient's life against all odds.
to save sb's life.cn: 医生不顾一切，竭尽全力挽救病人的生命。

to score a hat-trick.en: The striker scored a hat-trick, leaving the crowd in absolute ecstasy.
to score a hat-trick.cn: 前锋梅开三度，令观众欣喜若狂。

to seal a contract.en: They finally signed the documents to seal the lucrative business contract.
to seal a contract.cn: 他们终于签署文件，以落实这项有利可图的商业合同。

to skew the statistics.en: The company was accused of skews the statistics to hide its poor performance.
to skew the statistics.cn: 该公司被指控歪曲统计数据以掩盖其糟糕的表现。

to smile wryly.en: He smiled wryly at the absurdity of their ridiculous plan.
to smile wryly.cn: 他带着讥讽的微笑，看着他们那荒谬绝伦的计划。

to smuggle contraband.en: They were caught trying to smuggle contraband across the border last night.
to smuggle contraband.cn: 他们昨晚试图走私违禁品越境时被抓获。

to sow confusion.en: The politician's vague statements were designed to sow confusion among voters.
to sow confusion.cn: 该政治家的模糊言论旨在向选民制造混乱。

to spread scandal.en: The media quickly spread scandal about the CEO's private life.
to spread scandal.cn: 媒体迅速传播有关首席执行官私人生活的丑闻。

to stir up a debate.en: The politician tried to stir up a debate by highlighting minor differences.
to stir up a debate.cn: 该政客通过强调细微差别来挑起争论。

to stir up hatred.en: The politician's inflammatory speech only served to stir up hatred among the voters.
to stir up hatred.cn: 这位政治家的煽动性言论反而激起了选民们的仇恨。

to stoke a furnace.en: He tried to stoke the furnace, but the coal was too wet to catch fire.
to stoke a furnace.cn: 他试图生火，但煤太湿了，点不着。

to suborn a witness.en: The prosecutor claimed he had suborned a witness to testify falsely against his client.
to suborn a witness.cn: 检方指控他指使证人作伪证以反对他的客户。

to sue for divorce.en: After years of marital discord, she finally decided to sue for divorce.
to sue for divorce.cn: 多年婚姻不和后，她终于决定起诉离婚。

to sue sb for damages.en: The company decided to sue the negligent driver for substantial damages.
to sue sb for damages.cn: 该公司决定起诉那名疏忽大意的司机要求赔偿重大损失。

to suffer from claustrophobia.en: He suffered from severe claustrophobia whenever he entered a small elevator.
to suffer from claustrophobia.cn: 他每次进入小电梯都会患严重的幽闭恐惧症。

to suffer from insomnia.en: He has been suffering from severe insomnia for over a year.
to suffer from insomnia.cn: 他已受严重失眠症困扰超过一年。

to suffer from stress.en: He has been suffering from severe stress due to the demanding work schedule.
to suffer from stress.cn: 他因工作日程紧张而遭受严重压力。

to summon a meeting.en: The CEO decided to summon a meeting to address the company's recent financial losses.

to take a year's sabbatical.en: She decided to take a year's sabbatical to pursue her passion for painting.
to take a year's sabbatical.cn: 她决定休一年假专心从事绘画创作。

to take immediate action.en: The committee decided to take immediate action after reviewing the alarming data.
to take immediate action.cn: 委员会在审查了令人担忧的数据后，决定立即采取行动。

to take vengeance on sb.en: He decided to take vengeance on his former boss for the betrayal.
to take vengeance on sb.cn: 他决定向背叛他的前老板复仇。

to throw accusations at someone.en: The media frequently throws accusations at the government regarding its recent policies.
to throw accusations at someone.cn: 媒体经常就其近期政策指责政府。

to throw away an opportunity.en: She failed to seize the chance, ultimately throwing away a golden opportunity for her career.
to throw away an opportunity.cn: 她错失良机，最终葬送了职业生涯的黄金机会。

to thwart sb's plans.en: The sudden storm effectively thwarted the team's plans for the outdoor competition.
to thwart sb's plans.cn: 突如其来的风暴有效挫败了该队户外比赛的计划。

to tickle sb's imagination.en: The futuristic design truly tickled my imagination by blending technology with nature.
to tickle sb's imagination.cn: 其将科技与自然融合的未来设计令人遐想无限。

to tie a ribbon.en: She carefully tied a bright red ribbon around the gift box.
to tie a ribbon.cn: 她小心地系上了一条鲜红的丝带，将礼物盒捆好。

to tighten security.en: The government decided to tighten security at all major airports following the recent attacks.
to tighten security.cn: 政府决定在近期袭击后加强所有主要机场的安全措施。

to toe the party line.en: He always toed the party line, never daring to voice his own dissenting opinions.
to toe the party line.cn: 他始终紧跟党的路线，从不敢于发表自己的不同意见。

to treat sb with disdain.en: He treated his former colleague with disdain whenever he saw him in the hallway.
to treat sb with disdain.cn: 每当他在走廊遇见前同事时，总是轻蔑地对待他。

to trigger an alarm.en: The sudden noise triggered an alarm, causing everyone to rush for safety.
to trigger an alarm.cn: 突如其来的噪音触发了警报，导致众人奔逃避险。

to trust in divine providence.en: We must learn to trust in divine providence when facing life's inevitable challenges.
to trust in divine providence.cn: 面对人生不可避免的挑战时，我们必须学会信赖天意。

to undercut sb's prices.en: The company decided to undercut its rivals' prices to gain a larger market share.
to undercut sb's prices.cn: 该公司决定降低价格以击败竞争对手，从而扩大市场份额。

to unfurl a flag.en: The soldiers carefully unfurled the flag at dawn, signaling victory to the entire nation.
to unfurl a flag.cn: 士兵们在黎明时分小心地展开旗帜，向全国宣告胜利。

to untie a knot.en: She carefully untied the complex knot to free the tangled rope.
to untie a knot.cn: 她小心地解开复杂的绳结，以松开纠缠的绳索。

to validate a contract.en: The court ruled to validate the contract, granting the company its long-awaited legal recognition.
to validate a contract.cn: 法院裁定合同有效，使该公司获得期盼已久的法律认可。

to validate a theory.en: The experiment successfully validated the theory, confirming its accuracy under controlled conditions.
to validate a theory.cn: 该实验成功验证了理论，证实其在受控条件下的准确性。

to violate international law.en: The military action clearly violated international law and caused widespread humanitarian suffering.
to violate international law.cn: 该军事行动公然违反国际法，造成广泛的人道主义灾难。

to ward off criticism.en: He tried to ward off criticism by claiming the error was unintentional.
to ward off criticism.cn: 他声称该错误是无意造成的，以此推卸批评。

to weave a narrative.en: The author skillfully weaves a narrative that connects disparate historical events into a cohesive whole.
to weave a narrative.cn: 作者巧妙地将互不关联的历史事件编织成一个有机的整体。

to work for a pittance.en: She works tirelessly at the factory, earning only a pittance.
to work for a pittance.cn: 她在工厂辛勤劳作，却只挣得微薄的薪水。

to work towards a goal.en: We must work towards a goal by collaborating and sharing our resources effectively.
to work towards a goal.cn: 我们必须通过有效协作与资源共享来共同实现目标。

to write out a cheque.en: He decided to write out a cheque for the entire project budget.
to write out a cheque.cn: 他决定开具一张支票支付整个项目的预算。

total abstinence from strong drink.en: He vowed total abstinence from strong drink to improve his health.
total abstinence from strong drink.cn: 他发誓戒除烈酒以改善健康。

travel arrangements.en: The travel arrangements for our conference delegates have been finalized by the logistics team.
travel arrangements.cn: 会议代表的行程安排已由后勤团队最终确定。

uncalled-for comments.en: His uncalled-for comments at the meeting caused unnecessary tension among everyone present.
uncalled-for comments.cn: 他在会议上的不当言论使在场人员产生了不必要的紧张气氛。

unfailing support.en: She has been my unfailing support whenever I face difficulties.
unfailing support.cn: 她是我面对困难时始终给予的支持。

unrelenting pressure.en: The unrelenting pressure from investors forced the company to cut staff immediately.
unrelenting pressure.cn: 投资者持续的施压迫使公司立即裁员。

unremitting hostility.en: The unremitting hostility from rivals made it impossible for the team to focus on their training.
unremitting hostility.cn: 对手的无情敌视使球队无法专心训练。

unsolicited advice.en: He offered unsolicited advice that only made the situation worse.
unsolicited advice.cn: 他提供了不必要的建议，使局势更加恶化。

unsportsmanlike conduct.en: The referee issued a yellow card for unsportsmanlike conduct after the player kicked the ball at the opposing team's goalkeeper.
unsportsmanlike conduct.cn: 球员踢向对方守门员后，主裁判出示了黄牌以示对不道德行为的处罚。

unstinting support.en: The community offered unstinting support to the victims of the disaster.
unstinting support.cn: 社区对灾害受害者提供了毫无保留的支持。

unsustainable growth.en: Unsustainable growth has led to severe environmental degradation that threatens our future.
unsustainable growth.cn: 不可持续的增长导致了严重的环境退化，威胁着我们的未来。

unwavering support.en: The government offered unwavering support to the community during the crisis.
unwavering support.cn: 政府在危机期间始终给予社区坚定支持。

victims of oppression.en: The victims of oppression often speak out against the unjust systems that have long suppressed their rights.
victims of oppression.cn: 受压迫者常公开谴责长期压制其权利的不公正制度。

virulent criticism.en: The committee faced virulent criticism for their controversial decision to cancel the event.
virulent criticism.cn: 该委员会因取消活动的争议性决定而遭到猛烈抨击。

vitamin deficiency.en: The patient's severe vitamin deficiency caused persistent fatigue and muscle weakness.
vitamin deficiency.cn: 患者因严重维生素缺乏症导致持续疲劳和肌肉无力。

wage cuts.en: The company announced wage cuts to maintain financial stability during the economic downturn.
wage cuts.cn: 该公司宣布降薪以维持经济衰退期间的财务稳定。

weapons of mass destruction.en: The treaty aims to ban weapons of mass destruction globally.
weapons of mass destruction.cn: 该条约旨在全面禁止大规模杀伤性武器。

well-founded suspicions.en: The evidence provided well-founded suspicions about the company's financial integrity.
well-founded suspicions.cn: 该证据使人们对公司财务诚信产生合理怀疑。

wild fluctuations in interest rates.en: The economy suffered from wild fluctuations in interest rates, causing widespread financial instability.
wild fluctuations in interest rates.cn: 经济因利率剧烈波动而遭受广泛的不稳定。

women wailing and weeping.en: The streets echoed with women wailing and weeping as they mourned their lost loved ones.
women wailing and weeping.cn: 街道上回荡着妇女哀悼逝去亲人的哭声与呜咽声。

words of wisdom.en: She shared her words of wisdom to help us navigate the complex challenges ahead.
words of wisdom.cn: 她分享智慧之言，助我们应对前方的复杂挑战。
